how.ontime: Share of milestones on time; partner-caused delays cost extra points per day.
how.bad_count: 100 minus the penalty × bad jobs per 10 transactions.
how.jobs: Average score of manually logged jobs for the criterion.
how.on_time_delivery: % of deliveries on time, minus points for each day late caused by the supplier.
how.serial: % of serial / activation issued on time.
how.on_time_payment: % of payments on time, minus points for each day late caused by the partner.
how.renew_via_us: Score of logged renewals through us.
how.reminders: Few reminders: points lost per reminder per 10 transactions.
how.debt: Debt: points lost per debt case per 10 transactions.
how.complaints: Few unreasonable complaints: points lost per case per 10 transactions.
how.referral_support: Score of logged referred-customer support jobs.

f.crit1: Each criterion scores 0–100 as described under its name.
f.crit2: Data score = Σ (criterion score × weight) ÷ Σ weights.
f.crit3: Final score = {{a}}% data score + {{b}}% rating score (stars × 20).
f.crit3off: Final score = data score (manual rating is off).
f.levels: Levels: GOOD from {{good}}, FAIR from {{fair}}, below that WATCH.

time.f1: Each job counts by age: factor = the % set above. Jobs outside the scoring window have factor 0.
time.f2: Criterion score = Σ (job score × factor) ÷ Σ factors.
time.f3: So recent jobs weigh more than old ones.
time.allOut: All 3 jobs are outside the scoring window

types.title: Job types

common.lockHint: At the end of each month the app stores that month's score; locked scores are not recalculated.

common.f2off: Manual rating is off: final score = data score.
common.f3: When the rating differs from the data score by more than {{gap}} points the rater must give a reason.
common.f4: Levels: GOOD from {{good}}, FAIR from {{fair}}, the rest WATCH.
common.needReason: Differs by more than {{gap}} points: a reason is required
